text: The searches that allowed one to three enciphering slips (0207, 0212-0214) let through readings with all 24 known letters right. If the message was masked, the answer could be one of them.
Every such reading, K4's and the same search's on its 20 scrambled copies, regenerated and put through 14 pattern tests; masked slipped messages planted through 0207's search.

K4 above every copy in 1 of 56 comparisons (chance 2.67), caught by a fresh copy: no flag. Plants found: L13 none 3 of 3, L13 reversal 3 of 3, L13 X spaces 3 of 3, L13 X every kth 0 of 3, L20 none 3 of 3, L20 reversal 3 of 3, L20 X spaces 1 of 3, L20 X every kth 0 of 3. Rerun of 0219 with gate 4 given the four experiments' own controls (issue #88).
